name: @mercatus-liber/adapter-printful
description: FulfillmentAdapter (subsystem 41) backed by Printful's real v2 order API (POST /v2/orders draft, POST /v2/orders/{id}/confirmation to confirm+charge) and v2 webhooks. Proves fulfillment is genuinely swappable to a real dropship/POD provider, same shape as adapter-clerk/adapter-shopify/adapter-sanity proved for their own subsystems. Public surface is exactly FulfillmentAdapter; depends on @mercatus-liber/fulfillment only, for the types it implements, plus global fetch as the real HTTP client (no new HTTP dependency introduced -- mirrors adapter-shopify's graphql-client.ts convention).
